court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Bandra, Mumbai (FCA No.65 of 2021)
case_name: Sampada Paradkar vs Prashant Kashiram Paradkar
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife challenged the order granting divorce and custody to respondent-husband. The trial court allowed the petition and granted decree of divorce under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act. The appeal was filed against this order.

legal_principles.principle: The court may grant a decree of divorce under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: By this order, the Petition was allowed and decree of divorce was granted under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: The court may direct the custody of a child to be handed over in a phase-wise manner.
legal_principles.held: Instead of directing the custody of the child to be handed over forthwith, it was directed that it would be shifted in a phase-wise manner.

outcome.final_order: The final court order did not pass any orders in the applications filed by both parties due to non-compliance with the earlier order.
